bullets: Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $128,560 - $160,700
Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $136,000 - $170,000

This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance…
Be a subject matter expert on email, cross-channel and partner integrations, resolving complex product issues that arise.
Use financial and engineering context to contextualize total opportunity size (and business impact/ROI) of proposed product improvements
Develop and lead the multi-year product roadmap for your domain, driving development from concept through launch and ongoing maturity
Make synthesized recommendations on priorities by opportunity and timing
Partner with GTM stakeholders to ensure successful and measurable delivery of commitments
Own the Platform Roadmap: Define and drive the multi-quarter strategy for foundational services, ensuring the roadmap balances technical debt, scalability, and new feature…
Transition to Self-Service: Actively shift the platform from reactive, ’ticket-based’ support to a scalable, proactive product model by establishing paved roads and service…
Lead Cross-functional Integration: Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and Security leads to ensure platform solutions are extensible, compliant, and meet the unique needs of…
Drive Developer Productivity: Champion continuous improvements in APIs, SDKs, and sandbox environments to reduce time-to-first-deploy and cognitive load.
Measure and Optimize: Establish governance frameworks and KPI dashboards to track adoption, support deflection, and reliability, iteratively refining the platform based on usage…
Develop, communicate, generate excitement for and obtain buy-in of the product vision, strategy, and roadmap that aligns with the company’s goals and objectives.
Lead cross-functional teams to drive planning, design, development, and launch of products that execute on the vision
Deeply understand customer needs and collaborate with engineering and UX to translate into product requirements and use stories
Define key metrics to evaluate product performance, constantly analyzing data to inform product decisions and measure success
Manage relationships and expectations with a wide range of cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the organization
